image_integration.description: Your connection that can generate images, such as OpenAI Images (Settings → Integrations).

role.description: The role the picture is attached to the entry as, for example `hero`.

style_prefix.description: Text added in front of the saved suggestion to set the look of the picture.
style_prefix.example: Documentary photograph, natural light, no text, no logos, no people's faces.

style_note.description: The look of the photo, used only when AI has to write a suggestion first. Can be blank.

suggestion_key.description: The name of the field on the entry where the image suggestion is saved and read from.
